title: Hal Povenmire's visits from 2008 and his belief before he died in 2019 that the phenomenon was angelic

tellings.quote: But he said when I I know now to me it's um he believed it was angelic.

plain: A man named Hal Povenmire visited Chris Bledsoe in Fayetteville, North Carolina, from 2008 on, and before he died in 2019 he came to believe the strange things around Bledsoe were angelic. Bledsoe, a North Carolina man who says he draws UFOs to him and who has been studied by NASA scientists, passes on what Povenmire told him. It matters because it shows someone who looked closely at the events deciding they were spiritual rather than alien.
